scope: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength numbered batches above 17 only. Runtime, matching, prices and image manifests remain outside this research task.
sourcePolicy: Require an exact-batch producer or credible retailer source and a readable real bottle label before proposing a release. Calendar years never imply batch numbers. Search absence is not proof of nonexistence.
conclusion: No release after Batch 17 was verified as of 2026-10-17. Do not create Batch 18, Batch 19 or later catalogue entries from the available evidence. The only exact-name Batch 18 listing found was rejected after its photograph proved to show Batch 003.
proposedResearchSummaryKo: 2026년 10월 17일 확인 기준으로 배치 17 이후의 정식 출시를 입증할 자료를 찾지 못했다. 배치 18로 소개된 페이지의 사진은 실제로 배치 003이므로 신규 제품 근거에서 제외한다. 단종 여부는 확인되지 않았다.

sources.evidence: UK sitemap includes individual 10 Year Old Cask Strength pages for batches 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 and 17, plus a Batch 15, 16 & 17 set. No Batch 18 or 19 entry appears. The same sitemap includes Cairdeas 2026 and World Whisky Day 2026 pages, so it is not merely an unchanged pre-2026 snapshot. This is negative search evidence, not a guarantee of completeness.
Current official page identifies Batch 17 at age 10 and 58.3% ABV, with no dilution or chill filtration. It does not announce a subsequent batch. Batch 17 is outside this research file's entry scope.

rejectedOrUnverifiedLeads.reason: The page claims Batch 18, age 10 and 58%, but gives no bottling date or primary release evidence. The downloaded photograph visibly shows Batch 003, JAN 11, 55.3% and 700ml. Its Master of Malt affiliate URL also embeds the search term Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength - Batch 010 Single Malt Whisky and SKU 82217, so neither the image nor the retailer link corroborates Batch 18. The review is dated 2026-04-10; publication date does not prove the claimed release exists.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Real bottle-and-tube product photograph on white background. Both labels identify batch 003, JAN 11 and 55.3%; the bottle clearly reads 700ml and aged 10 years. The cache filename follows the rejected page's claim and must never be interpreted as verified Batch 18 identity.

searchOutcome: Exact-number and zero-padded searches for 18/018 and 19/019, a Batch 20 sanity check, and producer-domain searches returned no corroborated later release. Unrelated results included age-18/20 whiskies, independent bottler batch numbers and another distillery's Laphroaig-cask finish. The producer's generic whisky category was also inspected but its dynamic product list did not render fully in the text view; the readable official sitemap was used instead.
cautions: No official statement that Batch 17 is permanently the final release has been verified. Do not convert this research outcome into a discontinuation claim.
Community speculation alternately predicts Batch 18 or says it was cancelled. Neither constitutes release evidence.
Age-18 whisky and articles numbered Rare Batch 18 are distinct from Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 18.
No proposed Korean product copy, tasting notes or tags are supplied for unverified releases.
